name: typesafe-jev-mcp-tool-guardrail
description:
Screens MCP tools/call requests using TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model.
Sends the tool name and arguments to Jev with a configurable battery of typed questions (calibrated yes/no, a position on an operator-defined scale, or a choice between operator-defined options) and blocks the call with a JSON-RPC error when any question's answer crosses its threshold, or only records the hit in monitor mode.
The default battery asks whether the call is destructive, irreversible, sends private data out, reads secrets, raises privileges, disrupts a running system, or weakens a security control; with a configured scope, the destructive, irreversible, privilege and disruption checks do not flag effects the scope calls for (the exfiltration, sensitive-data and security-control checks still apply), and calls outside the scope are flagged.
Other MCP methods pass through; a request body that cannot be read unambiguously is rejected so the policy always screens the call the MCP server will run.
